name: 假睫毛级浓密纤长睫毛膏款
description: 锥形纤维刷头逐根捕捉睫毛，刷出假睫毛般浓密纤长妆效，不结块不苍蝇腿

styleLock.direction: high-saturation youthful masstige eye-makeup commerce: clean white studio packshots anchored by magenta-to-mint gradient scene cards
styleLock.backgroundSystem: pure white #FFFFFF for packshots; magenta-to-mint gradient #C2449A to #D9EFD9 for benefit cards; purple #9B59C7 and periwinkle #A9BEEC reserved for portrait and social-proof cards
styleLock.lightingSystem: even shadowless studio light on white shots, soft top-right key with soft lower-left shadow on gradient cards, macro top light plus side fill for brush details
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless backdrop paper and matte tabletop; skin is the surface for eye close-ups; a bold black mascara smear stroke is the only coarse texture motif
styleLock.typography: bold rounded sans-serif headlines in white or near-black, short handwritten-script accent words only, thin black leader lines for callouts
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line white minimal icons on rounded badges; red-ring dot markers for claims
styleLock.presentationRules: tube and wand always vertical or horizontal centered with labels fully facing camera; the wand must appear alone at least once; eye close-ups must use matched framing before/after
noDrift: no brand logos or source copy
no fabricated certifications or sales numbers
no new primary colors on gradient cards
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: high-saturation youthful masstige eye-makeup commerce across the whole set. Clean white studio packshots #FFFFFF with even shadowless light; benefit cards on magenta-to-mint gradients #C2449A to #D9EFD9; portrait and social-proof cards on purple #9B59C7 or periwinkle #A9BEEC. The glossy black tube #0B0B0D with mint accent #8CE6BC always faces the camera fully legible. Bold rounded sans-serif headlines in white or near-black #1A1A1A with short handwritten-script accents and highlight marks; thin-line white icons for claims and thin black leader lines for callouts. Soft diffused key light with subtle soft shadows on cards, macro top light plus side fill for brush details. Never shift the mint hue, never add props to white shots, never use serif fonts, brand logos, identifiable model faces, or unverified certification and sales numbers.

shots.intent: 点击页第一眼：管身外观与刷头一次看清，建立假睫毛级效果的品质预期
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level packshot, tube and wand standing upright side by side as two vertical columns, full products visible
shots.lighting: even shadowless studio light from top and both sides, faint bottom reflection only
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Centered straight-on eye-level packshot, tube and wand standing upright side by side as two vertical columns, full products visible. Even shadowless studio light, faint bottom reflection only. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. Product occupies 65% of frame. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no brand logos, no extra text, no decorative elements, no gradient background, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 三秒读懂三大卖点：不结块、逐根捕捉、深黑浓妆
shots.camera: product floating horizontally at a clean 90-degree side profile, wand detached to the right, medium shot
shots.lighting: even composite lighting, shadowless, brush stroke acting as visual shadow
shots.props: one large black mascara smear stroke angled behind the tube
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce benefit-callout infographic of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Product floats horizontally at a clean 90-degree side profile with the wand detached to the right, a bold black smear stroke angled behind it, three thin black leader lines ending in small dots. Even shadowless composite lighting. Magenta-to-mint gradient background #C2449A to #D9EFD9. Product occupies 55% of frame. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no watermark, no brand logos, no dense body text, no extra props, no fake certification marks.

shots.intent: 直击素睫稀短痛点，同机位上下对比证明假睫毛级妆效
shots.camera: matched straight-on macro of one eye at a slight 10-degree downward tilt, split vertically into two stacked equal panels with identical framing
shots.lighting: identical soft frontal-top light on both panels, consistent color temperature
shots.background: warm skin tone #E8B28E as the surface
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce before-and-after comparison of an eye wearing {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Two vertically stacked equal panels with identical macro framing of a generic model's eye, slight 10-degree downward tilt: top panel shows sparse natural lashes, bottom panel shows dramatic volumized lashes after application. Identical soft frontal-top lighting and color temperature on both panels, honest visible difference only. Skin surface #E8B28E. Small status tags reading in clean sans-serif. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no fabricated exaggerated results, no mismatched framing between panels, no brand logos, no watermark, no identifiable face features, no extra text.

shots.intent: 展示正确涂刷角度与服帖妆效，建立可复制的使用想象
shots.camera: straight-on three-quarter macro at 30 degrees, wand entering the frame diagonally from the upper third toward the lashes, eye centered lower frame
shots.lighting: warm soft key from the left with a slightly crisp shadow of the wand on skin
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. Lifestyle beauty macro of {product} in use. {product_identity_lock}. Straight-on three-quarter macro at 30 degrees, wand entering diagonally from the upper third, brushing the upper lashes of a generic model's open eye, eye centered in the lower half. Warm soft key light from the left, gentle crisp wand shadow on skin. Warm skin surface #D9A57E. Product dominates 90% of frame. Optional 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no distorted fingers or eyes, no identifiable face, no brand logos, no watermark, no extra text, no clumpy fake lashes.

shots.intent: 情感升温：笑容、妆效与产品同框传达自信结果
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level head-and-shoulders medium portrait, tube held in the near-left foreground
shots.lighting: soft frontal beauty light with a ring-light feel
shots.props: hand holding the tube, minimal jewelry
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. Lifestyle beauty portrait featuring {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Straight-on eye-level head-and-shoulders medium portrait of a generic smiling model holding the tube upright in the near-left foreground, mascara look clearly visible. Soft frontal beauty light with ring-light feel. Purple seamless backdrop #9B59C7. Model occupies 70% of frame with the tube clearly readable. No overlaid text. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no identifiable face or brand logos, no watermark, no extra text, no harsh shadows, no distorted hands.

shots.intent: 放大纤维刷毛与锥形轮廓，支撑不结块与逐根捕捉的可信度
shots.camera: straight-on macro of the wand standing vertically centered, extreme close-up with shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: soft top light plus side fill to reveal bristle texture
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. Extreme close-up macro of {product}'s tapered fiber brush wand. {product_identity_lock}. Wand standing vertically centered, straight-on macro with shallow depth of field, individual bristles and tapered silhouette razor sharp, a hint of black mascara on the fibers for realism. Soft top light plus side fill revealing bristle texture. Clean white #FFFFFF or pale mint #D2F0DE background. Detail occupies 60% of frame. Two short vertical claim lines in the right 30% column. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no blurry subject, no brand logos, no watermark, no extra text, no deformed bristles.

shots.intent: 用五项免除图标打清成分顾虑，强化温和安心
shots.camera: flat graphic layout: macro eye swatch in a white hand-drawn frame at left, headline band at right, five icons in a row along the bottom
shots.lighting: flat design lighting, no photographic light
shots.props: five thin white line icons, white hand-drawn frame
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce trust infographic for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Flat graphic layout: a macro eye-swatch tile inside a thin white hand-drawn frame at the left 40%, a bold five thin-line white icons evenly spaced along the bottom row. Flat lighting, no photographic shadows. Magenta gradient background #C2419C to #D15FB0. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no fake certifications, no brand logos, no watermark, no dense body text, no photographic icons.

shots.intent: 社交证明背书加速犹豫期决策，数据只引用可验证事实
shots.camera: top-down flat-lay, tube laid diagonally at center, medium shot
shots.lighting: soft top-right key, soft lower-left contact shadow
shots.background: periwinkle matte tabletop #A9BEEC with a magenta color block #B0298F
shots.props: magenta brush color block, small eye-cutout paper sticker
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce social-proof flat-lay of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Top-down flat-lay with the tube laid diagonally at center on a matte periwinkle tabletop #A9BEEC, one bold magenta color block #B0298F and a small paper eye sticker as props. Soft top-right key with a soft lower-left contact shadow. Product occupies 55%. Left 40% holds a clean proof block. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no invented sales figures, no brand logos, no watermark, no dense text, no fake review screenshots.

shots.intent: 为多色号扩展预留统一版式：换底色即换变体，主图色保持一致
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level single tube standing centered, full product visible
shots.lighting: even flat light with a soft oval contact shadow beneath
shots.background: per-variant pastel gradient, e.g. mint #7FD9B4 to #D2F0DE, blue #7FB8E8, pink #F088C8, lilac #C0A8E8
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. Product photography of {product} in one color variant. {product_identity_lock}. Straight-on eye-level single tube standing centered, full product visible with soft oval contact shadow beneath. Even flat light. Pastel gradient background tinted to match the variant, for example #7FD9B4 to #D2F0DE; keep the same layout for every variant. Product occupies 55%. Optional bottom variant-name strip. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no brand logos, no watermark, no extra text, no layout drift between variants.

shots.intent: 漏斗收口：产品+核心承诺+行动引导一屏闭环
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, closed tube standing centered, slight hero presence
shots.background: pure white #FFFFFF with a single magenta band #B0298F along the bottom
shots.props: thin-line icon row and round claim badges along the bottom band
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce closing promo for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Straight-on eye-level closed tube standing centered, even shadowless studio light. Product occupies 70%. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no fake discounts or countdowns, no invented certifications, no brand logos, no watermark, no dense text, no extra products.

provenance.notes: 源自 40 万+ 评级的平价睫毛膏 A+ 集；剥离品牌 logo、管身全部文字、皇冠心形图腾、模特可辨识特征（雀斑/鼻环）、原文案与手写体、销售节奏数字（转 proof placeholder）；渐变变体卡仅取版式
